posts.title: How to price interlock and hardscape jobs for 2027
posts.description: How to price interlock driveways and patios from your own costs: dig-out, base, pavers, labour by the crew-day, equipment, overhead and margin.
posts.excerpt: One per-square-foot rate for every interlock job is how driveways lose money. Here's how to build rates from last season's finished jobs, price labour by the crew-day and price to a margin, with a price sheet template to copy.

posts.title: Job costing for contractors: see each job's real margin
posts.description: A plain job costing method for 4–15 person crews: track labour, materials, subs and receipts per job, and see margin while the crew is still on site.
posts.excerpt: You know what the job sold for. Do you know what it made? A job costing method for Ontario crews: the five cost buckets, loaded labour, where HST goes, a worked patio example, and a winter exercise on last season's jobs.

posts.title: Ontario contractor year-end checklist for 2026
posts.description: A December checklist for Ontario contractors: T4 and T5018 slips, WSIB, HST receipts, the 2027 holdback change, records and a job-by-job margin review.
posts.excerpt: T4 and T5018 slips, WSIB clearances and reconciliation, HST receipts, the 2027 holdback change and records, each linked to the official page, plus the job-by-job review that's yours to do.
